definitions.explanation: A hooded pullover or jacket made of soft, thick sweatshirt fabric. It is a casual everyday garment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、スウェットパーカー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: In the morning, I put on a hoodie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でスウェットパーカー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フード→フード：28535_fuudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶった→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧。
examples.english: It was cold, so I pulled up the hood of my hoodie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧なスウェットパーカー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ジーンズ→ジーンズ：00123_jiinzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: On days off, I often spend the day in a comfortable hoodie and jeans.

notes:
A loanword combining "sweat" (referring to sweatshirt fabric) and "parka." It refers to a hooded sweatshirt, and is often shortened to ⟦パーカー→パーカー：04524_paakaa⟧ in everyday speech.

USAGE:
- スウェットパーカー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a hoodie
- ⟦フード{付|つ}き→フード付き：25744_fuudotsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スウェット→スウェット：28532_suwetto⟧: a hooded sweatshirt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦パーカー→パーカー：04524_paakaa⟧: hoodie; parka — the common short form, which can also refer to a non-sweatshirt hooded jacket
- ⟦トレーナー→トレーナー：21469_toreenaa⟧: sweatshirt — a sweatshirt without a hood
